limitations: Positions within a cycle have fixed order; this is a cadence/stability diagnostic, not a candidate-vs-baseline promotion benchmark.
Baseline cycles 0 and 1 pass all eight host screens; later baseline cycles and the requested-display-sleep probe contain external model activity and paging. Every result is retained.
The display-sleep request did not establish actual display power state; that probe cannot isolate lock-screen rendering.
No GPU clocks or power-limit telemetry was collected, so frequency, power, cache and scheduling mechanisms are unresolved.
Concurrent activity observed in this followup cannot be assigned retrospectively to the earlier complete ABBA comparison.
